g.text: As on the original, each resistor feeds two LEDs side by side: R1 the two left LEDs (D1, D3), R2 the two right LEDs (D2, D4), seen from the front.

g.desc: As on the original, each resistor feeds two LEDs side by side: R1 the two left LEDs (D1, D3), R2 the two right LEDs (D2, D4), seen from the front.

g.text: Use the same colour for both LEDs of a pair: of two different colours on one resistor only the one that needs less voltage lights.

g.desc: Use the same colour for both LEDs of a pair: of two different colours on one resistor only the one that needs less voltage lights.

g.text: 680 ohm (the maker used 100 ohm; his schematic says 140): about 1 mA per red, yellow or green LED on a 3.0 V cell or the badge's 3.3 V.

g.desc: 680 ohm (the maker used 100 ohm; his schematic says 140): about 1 mA per red, yellow or green LED on a 3.0 V cell or the badge's 3.3 V.

g.text: LED pad 1 (square hole) = cathode = short leg, toward the top of the board. LED lens on the front; resistor bodies on the back.

g.desc: LED pad 1 (square hole) = cathode = short leg, toward the top of the board. LED lens on the front; resistor bodies on the back.

g.text: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the LEDs. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.

g.desc: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the LEDs. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.

g.text: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.desc: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.text: LED-only board: SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not connected, so no series diode is needed on the cell (see docs/standard.md section 3).

g.desc: LED-only board: SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not connected, so no series diode is needed on the cell (see docs/standard.md section 3).

g.text: KIT PARTS: R1, R2 and D1-D4 are through-hole and are soldered by the buyer, as on hamster's original. They are not in the assembly BOM.

g.desc: KIT PARTS: R1, R2 and D1-D4 are through-hole and are soldered by the buyer, as on hamster's original. They are not in the assembly BOM.
